tag.name: TAG (Tight-Aggressive)
tag.description: Tight and aggressive: plays few hands but plays them hard
tendencies: Tight starting-hand range, mostly strong hands
exploitable: Steal his blinds often (he folds a lot)
Give more credit when he raises

lag.name: LAG (Loose-Aggressive)
lag.description: Loose and aggressive: plays many hands and raises frequently
tendencies: Bluffs often, but also has strong hands
exploitable: Set traps with strong hands and let him bluff
Fold less often against his C-Bets
Call his bets with a wider range

nit.name: Nit (Tight-Passive)
nit.description: Extremely conservative: only plays the very best hands
tendencies: Only plays premium hands like AA/KK/QQ/AK
Almost always has a strong hand when raising
exploitable: Fold medium hands immediately when he raises
Don't try to bluff him (he folds, but you can't win big pots from him either)

maniac.name: Maniac
maniac.description: Extremely aggressive: constantly raising and bluffing
tendencies: Bluffs a lot and rarely folds
Emotionally volatile and prone to tilt
exploitable: Patiently wait with strong hands for him to ship chips
Call down with medium-strength hands (his range is too wide)
Control the pot size to avoid being dragged by his aggression

calling_station.name: Calling Station
calling_station.description: Passive: rarely raises but loves to call down
tendencies: Loves to call but not raise
Almost never folds (especially to small bets)
Usually has a very strong hand when raising
exploitable: Value-bet against him (he calls with weak hands)
Fold immediately when he raises (he only raises with strength)

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.description: No data available — use default GTO strategy
tendencies: Not enough data — respond with the GTO baseline strategy
exploitable: Use GTO strategy and avoid over-adjusting
